purpose: Teach: 見送る/盗む/つど/痛快/くどい/本末転倒/滴/モニカ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、卒業生を、本気で、絶対、見送る、絶対、式、絶対、参加したよね
lines.en: Riku, you seriously showed up to the graduation ceremony, right?
lines.style: Casual check-in, slight rise on the question. She's testing him—playfully, not doubting. Light warmth under the surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。授業中、本気で、絶対、お前のノートの、絶対、答えを、絶対、盗む、絶対、なんて、絶対、しないぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. And I definitely didn't cheat off your notes during class, Sakura.
lines.style: Deadpan delivery with the faintest smile underneath. Dry, matching her energy. Slight defensiveness wrapped in humor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、試合に、絶対、出る、絶対、つど、絶対、活躍するよね、リク
lines.en: You always show up in matches, don't you? Every single time.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, direct eye contact in the voice. No sarcasm here—just straightforward pride in him. Steady cadence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の、本気で、絶対、漫画、絶対、痛快、絶対、で、絶対、止まらなかったぜ、桜
lines.en: That manga yesterday was so good I couldn't put it down.
lines.style: Animated, slightly breathy with excitement. Speaking faster than usual. The enthusiasm spills out naturally, not performed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の説明、本気for、絶対、くどい、絶対、時、絶対、あるよね、リク
lines.en: Though you do go on and on with your explanations sometimes, don't you?
lines.style: Teasing but affectionate. Light laugh underneath. She's poking him gently, the way you do with someone you're comfortable with.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験勉強、本気で、絶対、夜更かしで、絶対、本末転倒、絶対、にならぬ、絶対、よう、絶対、気をつけようぜ、桜
lines.en: Just be careful about staying up too late studying for exams, okay? That's backwards.
lines.style: Shifts to sincere concern. Slower pace, more deliberate. The teasing drops—this is genuine advice wrapped in her usual tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 帰り道、本気で、絶対、傘から、絶対、雨の、絶対、滴、絶対、落ちていたよ、リク
lines.en: On the way home, raindrops were falling off my umbrella like that.
lines.style: Quieter, observational. Speaking to herself as much as to him. Nostalgic, small moment captured in words. Soft trailing-off.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 転校生の、本気で、絶対、モニカ、絶対、さん、絶対、英語、絶対、上手だぜ、桜
lines.en: That transfer student Monica is really good at English, isn't she?
lines.style: Neutral observation with a slight smile. Not quite teasing, not quite innocent. Watching his reaction. Measured delivery.
